evidence.admission_variant: Ordinary admitted IRONCLAD .1, exported via the exact opening-admission immutable construction chain: endurance with side emitters, eligible jump, gun mounts, sensors and command deck. No world, live crew or simulation created. Native recipe and 98 parts/131 machines retained.
evidence.art_method: Exact native FMesher surfaces; orthographic editorial lighting, authored palette; not an Unreal screenshot. No invented room plan or damage.

gameplay_acceptance.basis: An export or successful build does not establish gameplay, visual, save, balance or performance acceptance.

geometry_counts.basis: Exported native mesh counts; not a runtime FPS benchmark.

role.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.

summary.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.
summary.value: An armored broadside battleship with 24 casemates across two decks, three heavy dorsal turrets, four protected reactor/control districts, separate magazine/feed routes, four shield emitters, two drive/fuel pods and ten attitude jets. Turrets and gunports use actual supported machinery, clearance and finite resources. This dossier is intended for the ordinary admitted endurance, gun-mount, sensor and command-deck variant. Exact assembled dimensions, mass and hardware are supplied by its matching native export.

fixed_architecture.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.
fixed_architecture.value: The two broadside decks, three dorsal turrets, citadel, supported drive/fuel pods and their feeds define this hull. Escape/recovery outlets and gunports do not establish assault-launch bays.

proposals.basis: Design proposals only; not implemented or certified compatible.
proposals.value: Alternative gun, quarters, engine-family or assault-bay fits require a separate explicit compatibility/design decision and native admission. No universal swapping, capacity expansion or free hardware removal is established.

supported.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.
supported.value: Existing finite ammunition and ordinary service follow the installed recipe. Source review does not admit IRONCLAD to generic gun or quarters outfitter choices. Its shared drive/tank modules fail the current independent-cartridge engine-family eligibility rule. Exported fitting flags must remain authoritative; a visible slot is not permission to fit it.
